# confirm / prompt — core-hub: uiConfirm / uiPrompt of shingo-core/www/static/app.js
# a fresh page per case; #opener has focus when the dialog opens. "after 60 s" is the
# fake clock moved a minute on: a dialog still pending then never resolves by itself.

## uiConfirm
uiConfirm(msg): the DOM it writes: focus #opener
    div class="modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
      div class="modal confirm-box" style="max-width:420px"
        p style="margin:0 0 1rem"
          "Delete <b>BIN-1</b> & \"its\" tags?"
        div style="display:flex;gap:0.5rem;justify-content:flex-end"
          button class="btn" onclick
            "Cancel"
          button class="btn btn-danger" onclick
            "Confirm"
uiConfirm: OK: resolves true, no overlay left, focus #opener
uiConfirm: Cancel: resolves false, no overlay left, focus #opener
uiConfirm: Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiConfirm: Escape on its OK button, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiConfirm: the page opened and hid a modal with this surface's showModal first, then Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiConfirm: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiConfirm: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays; OK on the second: first pending, second resolves true; then Cancel on the first: first resolves false, no overlay left
uiConfirm: OK clicked twice: resolves true, no overlay left
uiConfirm(non-string message 42): the message node:
    p style="margin:0 0 1rem"
      "42"

## uiPrompt
uiPrompt(msg): the DOM it writes, focus after a tick: focus at open #opener, after a tick input.form-input
    div class="modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
      div class="modal confirm-box" style="max-width:420px"
        p style="margin:0 0 0.75rem"
          "Delete <b>BIN-1</b> & \"its\" tags?"
        input class="form-input" type="text" style="margin-bottom:1rem" listens=keydown
        div style="display:flex;gap:0.5rem;justify-content:flex-end"
          button class="btn" onclick
            "Cancel"
          button class="btn btn-primary" onclick
            "OK"
uiPrompt(msg, {type:"number", min:1, max:9, value:5}): the input: type "number", min "1", max "9", value "5"
uiPrompt(msg, {type:"date"}): the input type: "text"
uiPrompt: OK untouched, no default: resolves "", no overlay left, focus body
uiPrompt: OK untouched, {value:"5"}: resolves "5"
uiPrompt: OK untouched, {value:0}: resolves "0"
uiPrompt: {value:"5"}, cleared to empty, OK: resolves ""
uiPrompt: typed "abc", OK: resolves "abc"
uiPrompt: typed "abc", Enter in the input: resolves "abc", no overlay left
uiPrompt: typed "abc", Escape in the input: resolves null, no overlay left
uiPrompt: typed "abc", Cancel: resolves null, no overlay left
uiPrompt: Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiPrompt: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
uiPrompt: over an open modal (this surface's showModal), Escape in the input: resolves null, the modal underneath open
uiPrompt: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays, focus input.form-input in overlay 2; Enter in the first: first resolves "one", second pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"

## uiConfirmWithInput (core-hub only)
uiConfirmWithInput(msg, {placeholder:"Reason"}): the DOM it writes, focus after a tick: focus input.form-input
    div class="modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
      div class="modal confirm-box" style="max-width:440px"
        p style="margin:0 0 0.75rem"
          "Delete <b>BIN-1</b> & \"its\" tags?"
        input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Reason" style="margin-bottom:1rem" listens=keydown
        div style="display:flex;gap:0.5rem;justify-content:flex-end"
          button class="btn" onclick
            "Cancel"
          button class="btn btn-danger" onclick
            "Confirm"
uiConfirmWithInput: typed "dent", Confirm: resolves {"ok":true,"value":"dent"}, no overlay left
uiConfirmWithInput: untouched, Confirm: resolves {"ok":true,"value":""}
uiConfirmWithInput: typed "dent", Enter: resolves {"ok":true,"value":"dent"}
uiConfirmWithInput: typed "dent", Escape in the input: resolves {"ok":false,"value":"dent"}, no overlay left
uiConfirmWithInput: typed "dent", Cancel: resolves {"ok":false,"value":"dent"}
uiConfirmWithInput: Escape on body, after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "modal-overlay active confirm-overlay"
